sentences.en: I used the interlibrary service to get a book on ancient history.
sentences.zh: 我利用馆际互借服务借了一本关于古代历史的书。

sentences.en: The university offers an interlibrary service for its students and staff.
sentences.zh: 大学为学生和教职员工提供馆际互借服务。

sentences.en: Thanks to the interlibrary service, I found a rare article in another library.
sentences.zh: 多亏了馆际互借服务，我在另一家图书馆找到了一篇稀有的文章。
